periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with a downward tilt of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval where the major axis is significantly greater than the minor axis.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Relatively flat U-shape with a subtle forward-facing concavity on the posterior edge.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band constitutes approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Gap between the two dark ear regions is approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular contour at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-tan pelage coloration covering the posterior dorsal region and hind limbs.
